cases.input: Two decisions cite the same issued source expression through separate citation acts.
cases.expect: One source expression remains independently resolvable while citation identity stays external and distinct.

cases.input: A source work is later retracted.
cases.expect: A work-level status event records source, observation and ingestion times; citations and decisions preserve history and reassess separately.

cases.input: A source publishes a corrected expression.
cases.expect: A successor expression is linked without changing the earlier expression or representation digest.

cases.input: A source expression exists in draft state.
cases.expect: The expression has no issuedAt and no abstract content digest; representations may carry their own digests.

cases.input: An authority issues the first retraction notice for a source work.
cases.expect: The status event can reference the registered notice source without requiring a pre-existing evidence event.

cases.input: A mutable URL is treated as stable source-work identity.
Equal external identifier strings from different schemes are treated as one work.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected without scheme, authority and equivalence evidence.

cases.input: A byte digest is used as the identity of an abstract source expression.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the collapse; digest belongs to a representation binding.

cases.input: Disposal erases provenance and cited representation fixity references.
cases.expect: Validation rejects disposal that breaks historical citation interpretation.

cases.input: A work-level retraction is stored only as a mutation of one expression.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the unmastered work status and requires an append-only work-level event.
